RESUMO

O

objetivo

desta

pesquisa

é

avaliar

a

precariedade

das

condições

de

trabalho

nas

práticas

de

produção

em

agências

de

publicidade

de

Porto

Alegre

-

RS

(2024-2025),

a

partir

de

relatos

de

trabalhadores

publicitários

e

de

gestores

empregadores,

tensionando

estratégias

de

visibilidade,

denúncia

e

possibilidades

de

enfrentamento

de

situações

causadoras

de

sofrimento

aos

empregados.

A

discussão

teórica

aborda

o

fenômeno

publicitário,

o

universo

de

sua

produção

e

seus

espaços

institucionais,

as

agências

de

publicidade;

além

da

articulação

entre

subjetividade,

trabalho

no

contexto

neoliberal

e

as

práticas

de

produção

no

campo

publicitário.

O

percurso

metodológico

compreende

uma

análise

documental

de

depoimentos

deixados

por

trabalhadores

publicitários

no

documento

compartilhado

Planilha

das

Agências

no

ano

de

2024,

somada

a

entrevistas

semi-abertas

com

empregadores

de

algumas

das

instituições

mencionadas;

para

posterior

análise

transversal

de

dados.

Os

resultados

evidenciam

que

o

cenário

da

produção

publicitária

no

contexto

pesquisado

(Porto

Alegre

-

RS)

é

marcado

por

condições

precárias

de

trabalho,

tais

como:

vulnerabilidade

das

formas

de

inserção

e

desigualdades

sociais,

intensificação

do

trabalho

e

terceirização,

insegurança

e

saúde

no

trabalho,

perda

das

identidades

individual

e

coletiva,

fragilização

da

organização

dos

trabalhadores

e

descarte

do

Direito

do

Trabalho.

Tais

condições

têm

como

fundo

uma

estruturação

contraditória

que

acompanha

diversas

problemáticas

do

projeto

neoliberal,

atravessando

e

tensionando

práticas

e

relações

de

trabalhadores

publicitários

e

seus

empregadores

gestores.

ABSTRACT

This

research

aims

to

identify

signs

of

precarious

working

in

the

production

practices

of

advertising

agencies

from

Porto

Alegre,

RS,

based

on

reports

from

employed

advertising

professionals

and

employing

managers,

and

highlighting

strategies

for

visibility,

denunciation,

and

possibilities

for

confronting

situations

that

cause

suffering

to

workers.

The

theoretical

discussion

examines

the

advertising

phenomenon,

the

universe

of

its

production,

and

its

institutionalized

places

–

advertising

agencies

–,

as

well

as

the

interplay

between

subjectivity,

the

activity

of

work

in

the

neoliberal

context,

and

production

practices

in

the

advertising

field.

The

methodological

approach

includes

a

documental

analysis

of

answers

left

in

2024

by

advertising

workers

in

a

shared

document

named

"Planilha

das

Agências",

in

addition

to

semi-open

interviews

with

employers

from

institutions

that

were

mentioned

between

the

answers,

for

subsequent

data

analysis.

The

results

show

that

the

he

advertising

production

landscape

in

the

studied

context

(Porto

Alegre,

RS)

is

marked

by

precarious

working

conditions,

such

as:

vulnerable

employment

arrangements

and

social

inequalities,

work

intensification

and

outsourcing,

job

insecurity

and

occupational

health

issues,

the

erosion

of

individual

and

collective

identities,

the

weakening

of

worker

organization,

and

the

disregard

for

labor

rights.

These

conditions

stem

from

a

contradictory

structure

that

follows

several

problems

of

the

neoliberal

project,

stressing

and

straining

the

practices

and

relationships

of

advertising

employees

and

their

employing

managers.

ABSTRACT

This

research

aims

to

identify

signs

of

precarious

working

in

the

production

practices

of

advertising

agencies

from

Porto

Alegre,

RS,

based

on

reports

from

employed

advertising

professionals

and

employing

managers,

and

highlighting

strategies

for

visibility,

denunciation,

and

possibilities

for

confronting

situations

that

cause

suffering

to

workers.

The

theoretical

discussion

examines

the

advertising

phenomenon,

the

universe

of

its

production,

and

its

institutionalized

places

–

advertising

agencies

–,

as

well

as

the

interplay

between

subjectivity,

the

activity

of

work

in

the

neoliberal

context,

and

production

practices

in

the

advertising

field.

The

methodological

approach

includes

a

documental

analysis

of

answers

left

in

2024

by

advertising

workers

in

a

shared

document

named

"Planilha

das

Agências",

in

addition

to

semi-open

interviews

with

employers

from

institutions

that

were

mentioned

between

the

answers,

for

subsequent

data

analysis.

The

results

show

that

the

he

advertising

production

landscape

in

the

studied

context

(Porto

Alegre,

RS)

is

marked

by

precarious

working

conditions,

such

as:

vulnerable

employment

arrangements

and

social

inequalities,

work

intensification

and

outsourcing,

job

insecurity

and

occupational

health

issues,

the

erosion

of

individual

and

collective

identities,

the

weakening

of

worker

organization,

and

the

disregard

for

labor

rights.

These

conditions

stem

from

a

contradictory

structure

that

follows

several

problems

of

the

neoliberal

project,

stressing

and

straining

the

practices

and

relationships

of

advertising

employees

and

their

employing

managers.
